params.body:
This repository touches every repository in the fleet, and it was the only one not held to what the fleet asks of each project: a remote, tests, and a judge that does not run on the machine of the accused. That cost the same thing twice in two days: the file-plan bug, and a run that aborted on a missing lockfile in the root. Both only visible in a client project's CI, after a hand had already run with them.

- `node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`, in CI on every push and pull request: the file plan as the workflow calls it (write, insert before a marker, running twice changes nothing, never writes outside the repository, an empty plan does nothing and says so).
- A check that `fix.yml` still parses and that its twelve inputs still carry the names every project passes: a renamed input breaks the whole fleet at once.

The package side runs npm and composer, so it stays proven in a project's own CI rather than mocked here: a test that imitates a package manager copies the code and proves nothing.
params.title: De runner haalt zijn eigen poorten: tests en CI
